label: UNDERSTANDING HIM

points.heading: Be genuinely curious
points.body: Ask about what matters to him, and listen for the why.

points.heading: Share a little of you
points.body: Connection grows when both people open up, bit by bit.
points.panel: “Can I tell you something I don’t share with everyone?”

points.heading: Notice and appreciate
points.body: Naming what you admire makes people feel seen.
points.panel: “I love how you talk about your sister.”

points.heading: Make room for quiet
points.body: Comfortable silences are part of closeness too.
points.panel: Take a walk together without filling every pause.

resource.name: His Secret Obsession
resource.covers: Ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection.

caption:
Attraction can spark fast. Emotional connection takes a little more time, and it’s what makes something last.

These four habits help you go beyond small talk. If you’d like more ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will feel.
